prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a paper runway; a cutout aircraft.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the strip becomes a runway torn short; a cutout aircraft rolls to the torn end and stops.
Ends holding on the runway.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "1.4 MONTHS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "1.4 MONTHS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "At that rate, the cash on hand covered one point four months.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action editorial paper collage shot from a top-down perspective, photographed flat under soft room light. The background is a single, unbroken block of deep magenta matte paper. A consistent light source from the upper left casts small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer. On the first frame, a rectangular cream paper chip slides in quickly from the top with a slight overshoot, landing stably in the upper third of the frame; printed on it in a large, extra-bold black sans-serif typeface is the text "1.4 MONTHS". Simultaneously, in the lower two-thirds of the frame, a long strip of grey paper with a realistic matte texture and rough, white torn edges slides in rapidly to form a runway, stopping abruptly as if torn short. Immediately following, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a commercial aircraft—completely blank with no markings, liveries, or symbols, and featuring rough white torn-paper edges—rolls quickly along the grey runway strip. The aircraft slows down and comes to a complete stop exactly at the torn end of the runway. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. A male narrator (S1), with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says <d>[English] At that rate, the cash on hand covered one point four months.</d> His voice begins exactly on the first frame. The composition holds steady for the final second, with the "1.4 MONTHS" chip and the aircraft on the runway remaining perfectly stable.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice, layered with tactile foley sounds. A crisp, rhythmic "slap" of heavy paper hitting a surface occurs as the headline chip and runway enter, followed by the subtle, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down. The aircraft's movement is accompanied by a soft, dry sliding sound of paper friction against paper.
